name: Unit & component
description: Fast checks of functions, classes and UI components in isolation.

name: API & integration
description: Service behavior through its public interface, without a browser.

name: Contract
description: Agreements between consumers and providers, checked without a full environment.

name: UI end-to-end
description: A thin layer of critical user journeys through a real browser.

name: Mobile UI
description: Journeys through the native iOS and Android app.

name: Mocks & virtualization
description: Stand-ins for third-party and unstable dependencies.

name: Ephemeral environments
description: Real dependencies started per test run, so tests never share state.

name: Test data
description: Synthetic, reproducible data created per test.

name: Accessibility
description: Automated accessibility rules in the same suite.

name: Performance
description: Load and performance budgets checked in CI.

name: Reporting
description: Reports with steps, attachments and history.
